answer.reason: The verses tell of events in Samaria: Philip preaching there and its people receiving the word of God.

clauses.english: heard Philip preach Christ and believed and was baptized
clauses.quote: when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God

clauses.english: received Peter and John, sent from Jerusalem after it received the word of God
clauses.quote: Samaria had received the word of God

doubts: Verses LUK 17:11, JHN 4:4-9 and ACT 8:9 mention Samaria, but the 'city of Samaria' in ACT 8 may be a city rather than the region; treated as the region.
The second clause says the apostles came, but the Holy Ghost was given only in verses not shown (ACT 8:17), so only the sending and praying are stated.
